reason: I already pay for ChatGPT and I'm not letting a new platform into my CRM and customer emails just because it says 'GDPR-compliant' in one line. The lost lead stings, but I might try the free plan and I won't pay 99 a month this week.
objection: Where does my customer data actually go, which AI models see it, and is it hosted in the EU with a proper data processing agreement? Also, what does this do that my ChatGPT subscription and a CRM reminder don't?
would_change_my_mind: A demo where it follows up a real lead from my own CRM automatically, plus a signed DPA showing EU hosting and no training on my data.
